title: Replicate bundles that vary the data give independent fitting replicates
hypothesis: Varying the demonstrations, the trajectory-level split, the probe manifest and the fitting seed together (qualification_v2 bundles) increases between-replicate uncertainty in the five seed-bank structures' fitted success relative to varying only the minibatch seed on one fixed bundle, so minibatch-only intervals understate uncertainty.

prediction.against: matched minibatch-only control arm: one fixed demo sample/split (seed 2700) and probe manifest (pool seed 2710), fitting seeds 2701-2705; replicate r of both arms is scored on the same qualification manifest (pool seed 2420+r)
prediction.rationale: success_se is defined identically in both arms as the between-replicate standard error of the equally weighted five-structure bank-mean selected success (sd over 5 replicates / sqrt 5), not binomial episode error. Because both arms share each replicate's scoring placements, the difference isolates data/split/probe variation. Interval: paired bootstrap over replicate indices (10,000 resamples); per-structure between-replicate spreads reported.

code_changes: scripts/qualify_fittable_bank.py (replication subcommand: data-varying arm and matched minibatch-only control, shared scoring manifests, success_se and paired bootstrap)

falsified_by: The upper 95% bound of the success_se increase is below 0.01. An interval including zero is inconclusive about increased uncertainty; mean success need not decrease for the mechanism to hold.

cost_estimate.breakdown: step-0 scoring 5 structures x 5 qualification manifests x 50 = 1250 (shared by both arms); fits 2 arms x 5 replicates x 5 structures x (3 probe checkpoints x 10 + 50 scoring) = 4000; no new demonstration collection (bundles sample the existing 150-episode buffer)

result.notes: success_se data-varying 0.0075 vs minibatch-only 0.0056: difference +0.0019, paired bootstrap 95% [-0.0034, +0.0054] over 5 replicate indices (crude at n=5). Upper bound is below the 0.01 threshold. Bank-mean success: data-varying 0.896 vs minibatch-only 0.911, paired t -0.0152 [-0.0484, +0.0180]. Per structure the data-varying sd is larger or equal in all five, but small except simple_reach_push_shared_gain (sd 0.088 vs 0.037): under two of five data bundles its probe selected step 0 (fitting rejected, success 0.62/0.56 = its step-0 level), never under the fixed bundle. All other fits selected step 1000. Both arms of replicate r scored on the same qualification manifest (pool seed 2420+r), so evaluation placements are matched. Seeds spent: 2400-2404, 2410-2414, 2420-2424, 2700-2705, 2710; 2405-2409 and 2415-2419 untouched. Episodes 1500 probe + 3750 scoring = 5250.

verdicts.reasoning: success_se rose from 0.0056 (minibatch-only) to 0.0075 (data-varying), +0.0019 with paired bootstrap 95% [-0.0034, +0.0054]; the predeclared falsifier is an upper bound below 0.01, met. Bank-mean success is unchanged within noise (0.896 vs 0.911). Data variation does widen spreads a little in every structure, and in one (simple_reach_push_shared_gain) it flips probe selection to step 0 in 2/5 bundles, so it is not nothing; but at the bank level the minibatch-only intervals do not materially understate uncertainty. n=5 makes the bootstrap crude.
verdicts.next_experiment: Keep the seed bank; flag simple_reach_push_shared_gain as data-sensitive (fitting rejected under 2/5 data draws). Future qualification can use data-varying bundles at no cost penalty, but this is not a reason to re-qualify.
